title: I built a game called Scoot with Friends
author: 999Jupiter999
selftext:
Well I've spent the better part of a month and a half working on this game and at times I have definitely gone off course and added too many features in the wrong direction, removing and replacing things multiple different times, changing menus and settings etc. 

But I feel like I've learned a lot along the way and today I hope to share some of the cool things that you can do in my game. It's fully available for free on the browser, and this is the first sort of release trailer that I have made. If you do check it out, please leave a comment or send me a message I would love to hear your feedback. 

We do have an Android release that is enclosed testing right now if anyone would like to join that as well, let me know. Thanks for having a cool space to share our creations!

\-Toasty Games
